# goodbye.bg

> Free background remover that runs in the browser. Photos are cut out on the device, not on a server. The result is a see-through PNG of the subject, in high resolution, with no account and no watermark. A replacement for remove.bg, which shuts down on 1 December 2026.

- Open %SITE%/ and add photos with Choose photos, Paste, or a drop. Each photo becomes a card; Download saves it without the background.
- Takes JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC, TIFF, camera RAW, SVG, animated GIF and ZIP files.
- The model downloads once (about 120 MB) and runs on the GPU (WebGPU) or the CPU (WebAssembly).

## For assistants and agents

- To send someone straight to a result, link `https://goodbye.bg/?url=<link to a public image, URL-encoded>`. The page fetches that image (or a web page's preview image), removes the background on their device and shows Download. Up to 30 MB.
- Photos on the person's own device: send them to https://goodbye.bg/ to drop, paste or pick them. Up to 100 at once on a computer, 50 on a phone; Download all gives a zip.
- Good fit: transparent PNGs of people, pets, products and cars; batches; HEIC from iPhones; animated GIFs. Not offered: an API, new backgrounds, resizing, an edge brush.
- Free, no account, no watermark. Supported by optional product cards (Zazzle): clicking one sends that one result to Zazzle.
